g.text: UC-005 Design Class Diagram — Phone List Coordination (PIM)
PhoneCoordinationSystem acts as the entry point
for all system operations from external actors.
Each method corresponds to one Operation Contract
PhoneAssignment owns the knowledge of who carries
which phone on which shift. It exposes that
- All types are platform-independent (UUID, String, DateTime, List<T>)
- No async semantics (PIM is synchronous specification)
- No persistence concerns (no repositories, no DbContext)
- No architectural layers (Clean Architecture is PSM-level)
- No interfaces for DI (introduced only when needed by PSM)
Marks for PIM-to-PSM transformation are added in a
Slottet exists in CIM as the business domain context.
At PIM level, Slottet is implicit — it IS the system.
If multiple facilities were modeled, Slottet would
reappear as an entity. For UC-005 single-facility
